blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A Catholic priest has called for a stronger culture of care for elderly Filipinos, urging families, communities and institutions to ensure that older people are not left behind amid migration, urbanization and changing family structures. Father Andy Peter Lubi, director of Hapag Aruga Foundation Inc., made the call Sunday, Oct. 4, during the foundation’s Elderly Filipino Week celebration at its home for abandoned and vulnerable senior citizens in Barangay Managpi.
